moments.title: Mark Knopfler's 77th Birthday

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Happy belated birthday to the masterful Mark Knopfler, who turned 77! His unique fingerstyle guitar changed the game. What's his most unforgettable riff for you?

angles.name: Solo Success
angles.copy: Beyond Dire Straits, Mark Knopfler has had an incredible solo career and soundtrack work. Wishing him a very happy 77th!
